Results.Title: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Excellent gas grill. Has all the elements I wanted and a few extra that I love.

The missing star in my rating is due to some improvements:
1. Manual: please include detailed instructions to troubleshoot when grill does not attain expected temperature. Had to call customer service.
2. It is difficult to install a full propane tank; please engineer an easier method; perhaps a lever?

Overall, I am VERY happy with my new Weber grill.
Results.Title: Very happy, a few improvements requested

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill that 99% meets my needs. Construction quality is what I expect of Weber and why I buy this brand. No frills that I don't need and don't work, like side burners. Clean design with hidden tank. Tank scale is accurate and an excellent feature. Only VERY minor issue is the iron grates - on one side, they have two slightly raised cross braces which makes it hard to slide a metal spatula under a hamburger. Luckily the grates are reversible and the bottom side is completely flat, solving the problem.
Results.Title: Love it.

Results.ReviewText: Compact but large enough grill area for a 4 person bbq. Grates are disappointing in the way they fit in the center, butting barely. Would like the tank base to be easier to lift, maybe slide, a full tank in place.
Results.Title: Best of the mini grills

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We are sorry to hear that your experience did not match your expectations. We are confident that your new Spirit E-210 will create many great memories with you and your family! If you continue to experience issues with your new grill, please contact our support team. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Grill. Previous grill was a Weber Genesis Silver which was 15 years old when I retired it. Yes I had to swap out some parts. The Genisis was a great grill. This Spirit is not going to last nearly as long. Like everything else these days it is manufactured with a specific service life to keep revenue flowing from my pocket to theirs. End of Rant and on to my problem. I accidently left the tank valve open the last time I used it and guess what, I am out of gas. Is that normal or should i look for a problem in the grill or the tank.
Results.Title: First Weber Grill was a Genesis with zero problems

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
